sourceData.readingMnemonic: To help you do this <kanji>dance</kanji> you need some <reading>boo</reading>ze (<ja>ぶ</ja>). Just enough so it's easier to think of nothing, let all your fears go, and dance.
sourceData.meaningInfo: If you want to do the nothing dance, just clear your head so there's nothing in it, and then dance!
sourceData.readingInfo: Feel the booze coursing through your veins as you dance like no one is watching.
